notes.title: League of Pixels - Update 4.0.5 - Control rework, big shop update, matchhistory
notes.content:
[h1]League of Pixels - Update 4.0.5[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348958/8d16479c9f547719ba138727dd4f8ada7e13543a.png[/img]
[h2]General Balance[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348958/8d16479c9f547719ba138727dd4f8ada7e13543a.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Matchhistory added
[*] Connection from "Receive -> Send" to "Every 0.1 sec" again
[*] New base stat: heal per second (health regeneration), every character starts with 1 heal per second
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348958/8d16479c9f547719ba138727dd4f8ada7e13543a.png[/img]
[h2]Health Balance[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348958/8d16479c9f547719ba138727dd4f8ada7e13543a.png[/img]

[i]Reducing health of many characters, and bringing some uniform into the amount of health that character classes have. (melee/ranged)[/i]

[list]
[*] [b]Hazel [/b]1050 -> 900
[*] Arel 800 (unchanged)
[*] Veil 700 (unchanged)
[*] [b]Arel [/b]750 -> 700
[*] [b]Sparrow [/b]600 -> 700
[*] Kira 650 (unchanged)
[*] Bunninja 650 (unchanged)
[*] [b]Foxy [/b]700 -> 650
[*] [b]Prim [/b]750 -> 650
[*] Puppeteer 600 (unchanged)
[*] Kumihu 600 (unchanged)
[*] [b]I'ceat [/b]700 -> 650
[*] [b]Flin [/b]700 -> 600
[*] [b]Belle [/b]700 -> 600
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348958/8d16479c9f547719ba138727dd4f8ada7e13543a.png[/img]
[h2]Character Balance[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348958/8d16479c9f547719ba138727dd4f8ada7e13543a.png[/img]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348958/e81455668ef295591c20d9f86ee187edeac17f5f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348958/082c44592ba9835b4f3346573a7c90f80fd999ed.png[/img][/url]
[h3]Kira[/h3]
[i]Reworking her enhanced J and making her smoother to play.[/i]

J Speed increased
J Spray reduced

J (enhanced) Auto target -> Skillshot
J (enhanced) Missiles 3 -> 4
J (enhanced) Speed 250 -> 300
J (enhanced) Range 75 -> 160
J (enhanced) Damage 40% -> 50% (120% -> 240%)

K Cast time, height and delay changed. (buffed)
K Damage per hit 70% -> 80%
K bullet speed 425 -> 475

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348958/8d16479c9f547719ba138727dd4f8ada7e13543a.png[/img]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348958/c235bf9929554f85296edf98c4266f0fd348027e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348958/d72d55efb3bf5600a516b34ee970124244d4b449.png[/img][/url]
[h3]Belle[/h3]
[i]In addition to her heavy health nerf.[/i]

K Speed buff 20 -> removed
L Speed buff 20 -> 40
L Cooldown 10 -> 12
L Damage per tick 50% -> 30% (200% -> 120%)

K and L now proc items on all instances of the abilities

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348958/8d16479c9f547719ba138727dd4f8ada7e13543a.png[/img]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348958/932773e56bae2dc34f56fb9af09b771105d379d8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348958/726b81fa94e7333bb0a993ff07fd6973d068edc0.png[/img][/url]
[h3]Kumihu[/h3]

K Slow 15 -> removed
K Damage 135% -> 140% (270% -> 280%)
L Heal 100% -> removed

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348958/8d16479c9f547719ba138727dd4f8ada7e13543a.png[/img]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348958/c28e720a0b30fe29a9967fcccb78da0e5026c8b8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348958/1d4ecb52d832cd4e24a2a75d4543677ce488012d.png[/img][/url]
[h3]Flin[/h3]
[i]Flin also got a heavy health nerf, so the rest of his kit will be untouched at first.[/i]

Speed 65 -> 60

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348958/8d16479c9f547719ba138727dd4f8ada7e13543a.png[/img]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348958/460bf0121ba2ef399162d807d6ab45ca754e1cdc.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348958/2d641e2077c997ab04d693bcaa07c14cc9d33bad.png[/img][/url]
[h3]Hazel[/h3]
[i]A bit more stun durations to compensate the health nerf[/i]

K Stun 0.4 -> 0.6 sec
K Dash Speed 175 -> 190
L Stun 0.75 -> 0.9 sec

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348958/8d16479c9f547719ba138727dd4f8ada7e13543a.png[/img]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348958/f8c8dae4ffa88c50156e926092f08021622f4ef5.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348958/4cc00556cfdcb7473fa3433ff10846a9a6e65ecd.png[/img][/url]
[h3]Puppeteer [/h3]
[i]Giving the puppet some more speed when attacking[/i]

Puppet speed 60 -> 75

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348958/8d16479c9f547719ba138727dd4f8ada7e13543a.png[/img]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348958/cc7f747cee46ed3f40abec9985104247a0c38947.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348958/3cbe5ec897e18690aab968d26eb5ef91edab84af.png[/img][/url]
[h3]Veil[/h3]
[i]Making skills a bit better to hit[/i]

J (enhanced) Range 50 -> 60
L (roll) Dash Speed 225 -> 325
L (roll) Damage 100% -> 150%

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348958/8d16479c9f547719ba138727dd4f8ada7e13543a.png[/img]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348958/e7d74ddee405305cf716e358aca643a7b2a3f421.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348958/0a289e38659a12aec29a525d03c5cab1a204caa6.png[/img][/url]
[h3]Prim[/h3]
[i]Compensation for the Health nerf[/i]

K Damage 150% -> 170%
K Slow Duration 1 -> 1.25 sec

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348958/8d16479c9f547719ba138727dd4f8ada7e13543a.png[/img]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348958/70254b8e77504057f5b18ccd43628055cba47b8f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348958/b03b65679a8b267330dc02c23334f7f90aa9ad89.png[/img][/url]
[h3]Sparrow[/h3]
[i]helping her out in addition to the health buff[/i]

Damage 40 -> 45

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348958/8d16479c9f547719ba138727dd4f8ada7e13543a.png[/img]
[h2]Item Balance[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348958/8d16479c9f547719ba138727dd4f8ada7e13543a.png[/img]

[h3]Wooden Sword[/h3]
Passive damage 10 -> 8

6 Damage

[h3]Light Slayer[/h3]
[i]now gives:[/i]
6 Damage
12% Attack Speed

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348958/8d16479c9f547719ba138727dd4f8ada7e13543a.png[/img]
[h3]Shadow Katana[/h3]
[i]now gives:[/i]
12 Damage

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348958/8d16479c9f547719ba138727dd4f8ada7e13543a.png[/img]

[i](unchanged)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348958/8d16479c9f547719ba138727dd4f8ada7e13543a.png[/img]
[h3]Hunting Crossbow[/h3]
Passive cooldown 0.75 -> 0.5 sec
Passive speed duration 0.75 -> 1.5 sec (can stack)
[i]now gives:[/i]
6 Damage

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348958/8d16479c9f547719ba138727dd4f8ada7e13543a.png[/img]
[h3]Relentless Longbow[/h3]
Attack Speed 24% -> 30%

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348958/8d16479c9f547719ba138727dd4f8ada7e13543a.png[/img]
[h3]Apprentrice's Staff[/h3]
[i]now gives:[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348958/8d16479c9f547719ba138727dd4f8ada7e13543a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348958/8d16479c9f547719ba138727dd4f8ada7e13543a.png[/img]

Passive Duration and cooldown 8 -> 6 seconds

notes.title: League of Pixels - Update 4.0.3 - Online fixed and new Ranged Minions added!
notes.content:
Welcome to the League of Pixels Update 4.0.3 changelog!

[h2]General[/h2]

[list]
[*] Huge online bugfix, providing a much smoother experience.
[*] Added new ranged-minions!
[/list]

[h2]Characters[/h2]

[h3]Puppeteer[/h3]
[i]Small rework to make balancing easier, smoother to play, and less toxic to play against.[/i]

[list]
[*] Health: 650 ⇒ 600
[*] Puppet Range: 70 ⇒ 85
[*] Puppet-return threshold: 80 ⇒ 100
[*] Puppet pullback is now faster
[/list]

[b]J:[/b]
[list]
[*] Puppeteer self slow 25 ⇒ 15
[*] Damage to minions 75% ⇒ 100%
[*] Speed 50 ⇒ 60
[/list]

[b]K:[/b]
[list]
[*] Puppet speed 100 ⇒ 160
[*] No longer flies further than Puppeteer's range (85)
[/list]

[b]L:[/b]
[list]
[*] Damage now upfront instead of after snapping
[/list]


[h3]Belle[/h3]
[i]Pulling earlier buffs back a bit.[/i]
L:
[list]
[*] Explosion damage per seed: 125% ⇒ 100%
[/list]


[h3]Foxy[/h3]
[i]Too much health for a ranged character, but making the L burst shot a bit more useful. [/i]

[list]
[*] Health: 800 ⇒ 700
[/list]
[b]L: [/b]
[list]
[*] Damage: 40% ⇒ 50%
[/list]


[h3]Hazel[/h3]
[i]Helping her dash a bit out. [/i]

[b]K:[/b]

[list]
[*] Speed 400 ⇒ 425
[/list]


[h2]Items[/h2]

[b]Light Slayer[/b]
[list]
[*] Damage and Healing: 10 ⇒ 15
[/list]

[b]Absorbing Wand[/b]
[list]
[*] Damage and Healing: 40 ⇒ 60
[*] Cooldown: 5 ⇒ 8 sec
[*] Damage over: 5 ⇒ 8 sec
[/list]

[b]Blasting Rod ⇒ Burning Rod[/b]
[list]
[*] Damage: 7% ⇒ 4% max health
[*] Cooldown: 5 ⇒ 1 sec
[*] Damage over: 2 ⇒ 1 sec
[/list]

notes.title: League of Pixels - Update 4.0.0!
notes.content:
[h2]League of Pixels - Update 4.0.0!
[/h2]

[h1]General:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Increased all stats by 10 to allow for better balancing (55 rather than 5.5 damage)
[*] Minumum speed while slowed is now 10
[*] Big [b]Shop rework[/b]!
[*] [b]Fog of War[/b] added. Players are now invisible inside bushes and when out of vision.
[*] [b]Gold gain:[/b] 4 every 1.5 ⇒  4 every 2 sec
[*] [b]Level-Up-threshold[/b] increase: 125% every level (exponential) ⇒  +20 every level (linear)
[*] [b]Maximum [/b]Level: 6 ⇒ 12
[*] Damage increase per level up 10 ⇒ 8
[*] Changed bottom jungle structure.
[*] Minion damage increase after the enemy tower falls: +40 ⇒ +10
[*] [b]NEW:[/b] Minion gain +10 damage and +5 speed for every kill you have.
[*] Turret health 2500 ⇒ 2000
[*] Maximum Death Timer: 20 ⇒ 25 sec
[*] Death Timer increase per 20 sec 2 ⇒ 1 sec
[/list]

[b]Heal Shrine rework[/b]
[list]
[*] Create a healing field, restoring 8% missing health every 0.5 seconds over 3 seconds. Both you and the enemy are affected.
[/list]


[h2]Item Shop[/h2]


[b]Wooden Shield[/b]
[list]
[*] Cooldown: 3 ⇒ 0.5
[*] Healing: 20 ⇒ 8
[/list]

[b]Holy Defender [/b]
[list]
[*] Cooldown: 8 ⇒ 30
[*] Healing: 100 ⇒ 300 when below 35%
[/list]

[b]Vampiric Shield[/b]
[list]
[*] Cooldown: 1 ⇒ 0.5
[*] Healing: 20 ⇒ 18
[/list]

[b]Frosting Plate [/b]
[list]
[*] Health: 80 ⇒ 150
[/list]

[b]Prestigious Armor [/b]
[list]
[*] Health: 180 ⇒ 220
[/list]

[b]Wooden Sword [/b]
[list]
[*] CD 3 ⇒ 0.25
[*] Damage: 20 ⇒ 10
[/list]

[b]Light Slayer [/b]
[list]
[*] Cooldown: 3 ⇒ 0.25
[/list]

Shadow Katana 
[list]
[*] Cooldown: 8 ⇒ 15
[*] Damage: 80 ⇒ 10% of the enemy's max health
[/list]

[b]Frost Ring Slow [/b]
[list]
[*] Slow Value: 15 ⇒ 20
[*] Duration: 2 ⇒ 1.5
[/list]

[b]Apprentice Staff [/b]
[list]
[*] Cooldown: 6 ⇒ 5
[/list]


[b]Blasting Rod [/b]
[list]
[*] Cooldown: 8 ⇒ 5
[*] Damage: 80 ⇒ 7% of the enemy's max health
[/list]


[h2]Characters:[/h2]

[h1]Flin[/h1]
Giving him a new passive to make spamming skills less useful. Now needs to trigger the passive mark before using another ability to deal the most damage. Also made his basic attack smoother overall.
[list]
[*] Attack Speed: 1.3 ⇒ 1.4
[*] [b]New passive:[/b] K and L now apply 3 stacks. Hitting J removes one stack and deals 40% of your dmg as bonus. Proccing all 3 stacks stuns the enemy for 0.5 sec.
[*] Triggering stacks no longer slows.
[*] J is now smoother and animation improved
[*] L now slows by 30 for 1 sec.
[/list]

[h1]Alvar[/h1]
Some quality of life changes.
[list]
[*] Speed: 65 ⇒ 70
[*] Smoothened 3rd J and K animation speed
[/list]

[h1]Arel [/h1]
Made him less spammy and more burst heavy with a bit more cooldown on his bomb, but more damage overall.
[list]
[*] Health: 800 ⇒ 750
[*] J Damage: 80% ⇒ 100%
[*] L Base Damage: 150% ⇒ 200%
[*] L Cooldown: 6 ⇒ 9
[*] L Slow duration: 1 ⇒ 0.5
[/list]

[h1]Sparrow [/h1]
Too strong. Nerfs to her base stats and the range and speed of her dash, making her a bit less mobile and easier to kill.
[list]
[*] Health: 700 ⇒ 600
[*] Speed: 65 ⇒ 60
[*] K dash speed: 600 ⇒ 550
[*] L missing health scaling: 15% ⇒ 12% of the enemy's missing health
[/list]

[h1]Belle [/h1]
Helping her waveclear a bit out and shifted her K slow towards buffing herself instead.
[list]
[*] K Slow: 15 ⇒ removed
[*] K Speed buff: 15 ⇒ 20
[*] L explosion damage: 0.5 ⇒ 1.25
[*] L  jump: 200 ⇒ 175
[/list]

[h1]Bunninja [/h1]
Less crowd-control, more damage. Shuriken are now harder to hit twice since they no longer slow and L's stun is less. In exchange, his overall damage was increased a lot.
The recast time of L-carrot was also halved, to reduce the area control of Bunninja after he throws it.
[list]
[*] K Slow per shuriken: 10 ⇒ removed
[*] K Damage on the way out 35% per shuriken ⇒ 70% per shuriken (Still 70% per shuriken on the way back)
[*] L Stun duration: 1 ⇒ 0.5
[*] L Damage: 1.5 ⇒ 2
[*] L Recast time: 4 ⇒ 2
[/list]

[h1]Hazel[/h1]
Less crowd-control, but some more mobility in exchange.
[list]
[*] Base Damage: 40 ⇒ 45
[*] Speed 50 ⇒ 55
[*] J Slow: 10 ⇒ removed
[*] J Self slow 35 ⇒ 15
[*] L Stun: 0.9 ⇒ 0.75
[/list]

[h1]Veil [/h1]
Easier to take down and less crowd-control. Shifting the slow from K to giving her speed instead.
[list]
[*] Health 750 ⇒ 700
[*] Speed 65 ⇒ 60
[*] J Self slow 25 ⇒ 20
[*] K Slow: 25 ⇒ removed
[*] K Now gives 25 speed for 1 second when hitting the enemy.
[*] L Stun 0.6 ⇒ 0.5
[/list]


[h1]Puppeteer [/h1]
Less toxic to play against, but also some more situational power in exchange.
Most noticeable is the movement of the puppet's attack, which got reduced by 40%. To compensate that change, K now has more range to give him better situational placement of the puppet instead of constant movement.
L now has more room to move without being snapped, but also lasts longer.
[list]
[*] Health: 750 ⇒ 650
[*] Attack Speed: 1.45 ⇒ 1.55
[*] J Self slow 30 ⇒ 25
[*] J Puppet speed when attacking 100 ⇒ 60
[*] K Slow: 20 ⇒ removed
[*] K Puppet dash duration 0.3 ⇒ 0.5 (more distance to compensate the previous J change)
[*] L Snapback radius: 60 ⇒ 70
[*] L Duration 2.5 ⇒ 3
[*] L Slow 20 ⇒ 15
[/list]

[h1]Kira[/h1]
Made her less toxic generally and easier to kill. Especially a nerf to her auto-target J missiles and her K slow.
[list]
[*] Health: 700 ⇒ 650
[*] J Empowered lock distance: 100⇒> 75
[*] J Empowered damage: 150% ⇒ 120%
[*] K Slow: 30 ⇒ removed
[/list]

[h1]I'ceat[/h1]
Some nerfs to give the enemy more time to fight back or run away.
[list]
[*] J Slow: 15 ⇒ 10
[*] K 3rd strike bonus damage: 150% ⇒ 125%
[*] K Slow duration: 2 ⇒ 1.75
[*] L Duration: 0.8 ⇒ 0.6
[*] I Speed buff: 50 ⇒ 60
[*] L jump: 150 ⇒ 75
[/list]

[h1]Kumihu[/h1]
A small buff to her dps, but nerfed her survivability a bit.
[list]
[*] Attack Speed 1.2 ⇒ 1.4
[*] K Slow: 10 ⇒ removed
[*] L Healing: 125% ⇒ 100%
[/list]

[h1]Prim[/h1]
As part of the overall slow nerf, her K now does not need that much slow now.
[list]
[*] K Slow: 30 ⇒ 20
[/list]


[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Now only local minions get the speed buff when the tower is destroyed.
[*] Removed Self turret damage when you destroy the enemy turret.
[/list]

notes.title: League of Pixels - Update 3.5.0 - Leaderboards added!
notes.content:
Welcome to the League of Pixels Update 3.5.0 changelog!

[h2]General[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added leaderboard in combination with your Steam account. Play to become the number [b]ONE[/b]!
[*] Exact numbers for character abilities are now visible in the character selection.
[/list]

[h2]Characters[/h2]

[h3]Belle[/h3]
[i]The last nerf was a bit much.[/i]

J: 
[list]
[*] Hitbox size increased 23 ⇒ 31 px
[/list]
K: 
[list]
[*] First Damage 100% ⇒ 150%
[/list]
L:
[list]
[*] Slow Duration 1 ⇒ 1.5 seconds 
[/list]

[h3]Bunninja[/h3]
[i]Nerf and power shift to late game.
[/i]
Stats:
[list]
[*] Damage 5 ⇒ 4
[*] Speed 65 ⇒ 70
[*] Health 70 ⇒ 65
[/list]
J:
[list]
[*] Attack Speed 2.5 ⇒ 2 per second
[/list]

K: 
[list]
[*] Damage on the way out 40% ⇒ 35% (120% ⇒ 105% for all three)
[*] Damage on the way back 50% ⇒ 65% (150% ⇒ 195% for all three)
[/list]

[h3]Foxy[/h3]
[i]Making J and L both more situational. J for long range poke and L for short range burst with waveclear.
[/i]
J: 
[list]
[*] Self slow 25 ⇒ 20
[*] Reload speed now also scales with attack speed bonuses
[*] Reload speed 1.3 ⇒ 1.5 seconds
[/list]

L:
[list]
[*] Range 120 ⇒ 90 px
[/list]

[h3]Hazel[/h3]
[i]Making her rely more on K for mobility, while punishing her, if K is on cooldown.
[/i]
Stats:
[list]
[*] Speed 55 ⇒ 50
[/list]

J: 
[list]
[*] 2nd hit (pre explosion) Damage 75 ⇒ 60%
[/list]
K: 
[list]
[*] Cooldown 7 ⇒ 6 seconds
[/list]

[h3]Flin[/h3]
[i]Small nerfs.[/i]

J:
[list]
[*] Attack speed 1.4 ⇒ 1.3 per second
[/list]

L:
[list]
[*] Damage 100% ⇒ 80% (300% ⇒ 240% for all three)
[/list]

[h3]Kira[/h3]
[i]Attack speed fix. Adding her more mobility at the cost of being squishier.
[/i]
Stats:
[list]
[*] Health 80 ⇒ 70
[/list]

J:
[list]
[*] Attack speed is now as intented (about the half as before)
[/list]

K:
[list]
[*] Cooldown 10 ⇒ 9 seconds
[/list]
